description: ONE production-oriented modular mountain CLIFF FACE, not a scenery picture or sprite sheet. Native 64x96 pixel-art canvas, transparent background. A continuous rugged slate-grey vertical rock face occupying full width from x=0 to63, elevation drop 56 native pixels. Irregular angular exposed strata, broad cracked slabs, deep cool crevices, moss sparingly in cracks. Narrow weathered taupe soil and moss cap at y=16..23, continuous face down to y=79, dark basal contact at y=80..87; empty transparent above and below. Left and right edges meet same cap and foot heights for horizontal joining; cut flush at left/right, do not round into an isolated boulder. Small top lip only, NOT a broad tabletop. Upper-left light. Blueprint crop guides rock geology and muted colors ONLY, omit its water/trees/architecture. Existing owned mossy rock guides pixel clusters/palette, not boulder silhouette. No buildings, stairs, trees, flowers, river, text, labels, masonry blocks or black outline box. Crisp coherent one-pixel clusters, no antialiasing. Return individual module variants; no arranged sheet.
